title: Has This Checkpoint Been Abliterated? A Two-Signal Audit and Its Failure Map
abstract: arXiv:2607.01854v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Can a platform tell, before deployment, whether an open-weight checkpoint has had its refusal mechanism stripped? Runtime guards cannot: they score generations, not the artifact. We combine two cheap internal signals, a reference-anchored activation refusal-gap and a weight-recovery energy of the base-to-candidate weight difference, into a threshold-free checkpoint audit. The two are negatively correlated and label-complementary: the gap supplies refusal-specificity and the weight energy supplies recall. On a 273-checkpoint registry spanning Qwen, DeepSeek-distilled Qwen, Llama, and Gemma, their z-sum separates 57 public abliterations from 37 benign fine-tunes, merges, and instruction-tunes at AUROC 0.95, significantly above either signal alone (0.84, 0.90), and a Youden-calibrated threshold transfers to held-out families at balanced accuracy 0.89 (FPR 0.11), missing only 4 of 57. translated_title: 这个检查点是否已被“擦除”？一项双信号审计及其失败图谱
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.01854v2 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：平台能否在部署前判断一个开放权重检查点是否已被剥离其拒绝机制？运行时防护无法做到：它们评分的是生成结果，而非工件本身。我们结合两种廉价内部信号——基于参考锚定的激活拒绝间隙和基础到候选权重差异的权重恢复能量——构成一种无阈值的检查点审计方法。这两种信号负相关且标签互补：间隙提供拒绝特异性，权重能量提供召回率。在包含Qwen、DeepSeek蒸馏Qwen、Llama和Gemma的273个检查点注册表中，它们的z分数和能将57个公开擦除模型与37个良性微调、合并和指令调优模型区分开，AUROC达到0.95，显著高于任一单独信号（0.84、0.90），且经Youden校准的阈值可迁移至留出家族，平衡准确率为0.89（假阳性率0.11），仅漏检57个中的4个。随后，我们按严重程度映射了两种失败模式。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合激活拒绝间隙和权重恢复能量的双信号无阈值审计方法，可在部署前有效检测开放权重检查点是否被剥离拒绝机制，AUROC达0.95，并分析了两种失败模式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a threshold-free dual-signal audit combining activation refusal-gap and weight-recovery energy to detect abliterated checkpoints before deployment, achieving AUROC 0.95, and maps two failure modes.
